_comment: What each cited line SAID when a person last confirmed the citation, as a digest of the span's content with leading and trailing whitespace removed. backend/tools/audit-citations.py compares against this and reports a citation whose target line has changed underneath it.
_why: The checker's older half asks whether a citation RESOLVES -- the path exists, the line is in range. That is mechanical and it is not the failure this repo actually has. A review on 2026-08-18 found four citations that resolved perfectly and named the wrong line, one of them a blank line; every one passed. See docs/adr/0010-the-doc-layer-checks-citations-not-documents.md.
_limit: A MATCH PROVES THE LINE HAS NOT CHANGED SINCE IT WAS CONFIRMED, NEVER THAT THE CLAIM WAS RIGHT WHEN CONFIRMED. A citation written wrong is snapshotted wrong and stays green. This file is therefore a record of human assertions, and `--update-snapshots` is the act of making them: run it after RE-READING what changed, not to clear a red run.
